prompt: Add a pricing page at /pricing with three plan cards (Free, Team, Enterprise). Each card has a name, a price, a short feature list and a call-to-action button. Make the middle plan stand out.
Add a settings page at /settings with a profile section (name and email fields, a Save button) and a danger zone with a Delete account button that asks for confirmation before it does anything.
Create a Toolbar component with a title on the left and a group of action buttons on the right, and use it on a new /reports page above an empty-state message.
Create a Notice component for success, warning and error messages with an icon area, a message and a dismiss button, and show one of each on a new /notices page.
Add a /dashboard page with a row of four stat tiles (a label and a large number each) and a recent-activity list underneath. It must look fine in the dark theme.
Add a /contact page with a contact form: name, email, message and a Send button. Disable Send until all three fields have something in them.
